open_items: ECB healthy -> gateway_issue, new as of cycle 1236, still present at cycle 1237 (two consecutive cycles). Gateway data probe fails with 'provider unreachable' after the full ~30s timeout; direct path is fine. Live recheck reproduced it: ECB now hangs (no response at all) on Accept: application/vnd.sdmx.data+csv;version=1.0.0, instead of its previous fast 406, so sdmx_progressive_client.py's fetch_data_probe never reaches its text/csv retry and burns the whole budget. text/csv directly answers in ~1s. This is a code bug on our side (gateway_issue), not a provider outage. See incidents.md cycle 1237 entry for the recommended fix. Watch next cycle; not yet actioned.

ILO provider_down -> healthy, recovered by cycle 1235. Fourth episode of the chronic Cloudflare-403 flapping pattern (cycles 1222, 1232, 1234), resolved the same way as before within 1-2 cycles. No action needed, already tracked as chronic.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1237. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
133 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run. Still well above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.

main freshness not reconfirmed this run; this run's own merge-to-main attempt is reported separately in the session output. If it fails, findings stay recorded on this branch and the next run's branch-scan will pick them up.

Monitor bug noted previously: /api/history computes status without contracts, so a contract-only degraded state never shows up in /api/history, only in /api/status. Not re-confirmed this run since no contract-only state occurred, but still believed true.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
